name: nll_loss_backward
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::nll_loss_backward(Tensor grad_output, Tensor self, Tensor target, Tensor? weight, int reduction, SymInt ignore_index, Tensor total_weight) -> Tensor. Computes the input gradient for one- and two-dimensional negative log likelihood loss without mutating or aliasing any argument. Tests cover none, mean, and sum reduction, weighted and unweighted gradients, in-range and sentinel ignore indices, scalar and batched targets, noncontiguous inputs, all-ignored mean reduction, output metadata, and floating dtypes retained from the legacy backward suite.
